scientific_target: refine Stage 1.3 same-recorded-chemistry candidate families into a simple same-recorded-architecture baseline
chemistry_source: Stage 1.3 chemistry_group_id is accepted as the chemistry grouping and is not recomputed in Stage 1.4
matching_rule: two frameworks are in the same Stage 1.4 architecture group only when chemistry_group_id, topology, and dimensionality all match exactly
missing_label_policy: missing topology or dimensionality is ambiguous and is excluded from validated same-architecture groups
geometry_policy: measured geometry is excluded from the architecture key and is evaluated only after architecture groups are defined
topology_policy: recorded topology is used as a practical architecture label; it is not claimed to be perfect ground truth
pair_policy: no framework pairs are constructed in Stage 1.4
outcome_policy: no adsorption or process outcomes are read
known_limitations: Stage 1.3 chemistry is a recorded-chemistry candidate definition, not proof of molecular identity
recorded topology may be missing or imperfect
same topology plus dimensionality is a practical architecture proxy, not an atom-level graph proof
missing architecture labels are conservatively treated as ambiguous
